focus_areas: Front wheel structural integrity and circularity
Wheel rim definition and separation from ground
Vehicle-ground contact points and edge bleeding
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay extreme attention to the front wheel. In AI-generated images, wheels often fail to maintain circular geometry or separate cleanly from the ground. Verify if the 'mud' on the wheel is actually part of the wheel structure melting into the terrain. Use geometric depth to prove the wheel is not a distinct object resting on the surface. Also, check if the side windows have consistent spacing and vertical alignment, as AI often warps repetitive patterns.
image_description: A white minibus (resembling a Ford Transit or similar van chassis) parked on a muddy, unpaved surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of side windows along the passenger compartment, and a dark lower trim. The front wheel appears significantly deformed or melted into the ground.
